## DPStyleARFootwearRendererInput.right property

Tracking data for right-foot footwear rendering. - detected: Whether the right footwear has been detected in the camera frame. - trans: The translation (position) of the right foot target. - quat: The quaternion representing the right foot target orientation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
right: {
        detected: boolean;
        trans: number[];
        quat: number[];
    };
```
